info.title: Slack Web API (AgentCore Gateway target)
info.description: OpenAPI schema for the subset of Slack Web API methods exposed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway 'Slack' integration template. Modelled on the operations documented under 'Built-in templates from integration providers as targets > Slack Web'. All calls are authenticated with an OAuth2 user token (Authorization: Bearer) vended by the gateway's AgentCore Identity credential provider.

post.description: Sends a message to a channel.

channel.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel to send the message to. Can be an encoded ID or a name.

text.description: The primary text content of the message.

blocks.description: A JSON-encoded array of layout blocks.

thread_ts.description: Provide the ts value of another message to make this message a reply in that thread.

reply_broadcast.description: When replying in a thread, also send the reply to the channel.

unfurl_links.description: Enable unfurling of primarily text-based content.

post.description: Sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel, visible only to the assigned user.

channel.description: Channel to send the ephemeral message to.

user.description: ID of the user who will receive the ephemeral message.

text.description: The primary text content of the message.

blocks.description: A JSON-encoded array of layout blocks.

thread_ts.description: The ts of another message to reply to in a thread.

post.description: Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation.

name.description: Name of the public or private channel to create.

is_private.description: Create a private channel instead of a public one.

team_id.description: Encoded team id to create the channel in, required if org token is used.

get.description: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Conversation ID to fetch history for.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's response_metadata.next_cursor.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp will be included.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp will be included.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

channel.description: The ID of the public or private channel to invite users to.

users.description: A comma separated list of user IDs (up to 1000).

channel.description: ID of the channel to join.

post.description: Removes a user from a conversation.

channel.description: ID of the conversation to remove the user from.

get.description: Lists all channels in a Slack team.

parameters.name: exclude_archived
parameters.description: Set to true to exclude archived channels from the list.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of channel types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: ID of the conversation to retrieve members for.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

post.description: Opens or resumes a direct message or multi-person direct message.

users.description: Comma separated list of 1-8 user IDs to open a DM/MPIM with.

channel.description: Resume a conversation by supplying an im or mpim's ID.

return_im.description: Boolean, indicates you want the full IM channel definition in the response.

get.description: Retrieves a thread of messages posted to a conversation.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Conversation ID to fetch the thread from.

parameters.name: ts
parameters.description: Unique identifier of either a thread's parent message or a message in the thread.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

post.description: Sets the topic for a conversation.

channel.description: Conversation ID to set the topic of.

topic.description: The new topic string. Does not support formatting or linkification.

get.description: Lists files for a team, in a channel, or from a user with applied filters.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Filter files appearing in a specific channel, indicated by its ID.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Filter files created by a single user.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Filter files by type, comma-separated: all, spaces, snippets, images, gdocs, zips, pdfs.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of results to return.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Specify a file by providing its ID.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of comments to return per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of comments to return.

get.description: Searches for messages and files matching a query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Return matches sorted by either score or timestamp.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Change sort direction to ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of results to return.

name.description: A name for the User Group. Must be unique among User Groups.

handle.description: A mention handle. Must be unique among channels, users and User Groups.

description.description: A short description of the User Group.

get.description: Lists all User Groups for a team.

parameters.name: include_disabled
parameters.description: Include disabled User Groups.

parameters.name: include_count
parameters.description: Include the number of users in each User Group.

parameters.name: include_users
parameters.description: Include the list of users for each User Group.

post.description: Updates the list of users for a User Group.

usergroup.description: The encoded ID of the User Group to update.

users.description: A comma separated string of encoded user IDs that represent the entire list of users for the User Group.

get.description: Lists all users in a Slack team.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (0-1000).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: include_locale
parameters.description: Set to true to receive the locale for users.

time.description: When this reminder should happen: a Unix timestamp, a number of seconds from now, or a natural language description of a time.

user.description: The user who will receive the reminder. Defaults to the authenticated user.

post.description: Sets the profile information for a user.

profile.description: Collection of key:value pairs presented as a URL-encoded JSON hash.

name.description: Name of a single profile field to set.

value.description: Value to set a single profile field to.

user.description: ID of user to change (admin only).

get.description: Gets a URL for an edge external file upload.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Name of the file being uploaded.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Size in bytes of the file being uploaded.

parameters.name: alt_txt
parameters.description: Description of image for screen-reader.

parameters.name: snippet_type
parameters.description: Syntax type of the snippet being uploaded.

post.description: Finalizes an upload started with files.getUploadURLExternal.

files.description: JSON-encoded array of file objects, each with an id and optional title.

channel_id.description: Channel ID where the file(s) will be shared.

initial_comment.description: The message text introducing the file(s).

thread_ts.description: Provide the ts value of the parent message to upload the file(s) as a thread reply.

SlackOAuth.description: Slack 3-legged OAuth. The access token is vended by the AgentCore Identity credential provider and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

scopes.chat:write: Send messages on the user's behalf
scopes.search:read: Search the user's messages and files
scopes.channels:read: View basic information about public channels
scopes.channels:write: Manage public channels and create new ones

SlackOk.description: Standard Slack Web API response. Slack returns HTTP 200 even for logical errors; inspect the 'ok' field and, when false, the 'error' field.

SlackResponse.description: Envelope common to all Slack Web API responses.

ok.description: true if the request succeeded, false otherwise.

error.description: Error code present when ok is false.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass as the 'cursor' parameter to fetch the next page.
